{{Quote|All I can say is it's a mercy Orko is paying for it.|Gorga expresses his relief at the fact his father in law is paying for his wedding feast|<ref name="BF:WTFLS" />}}
'''Ubuuga caviar''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Twelve [[Imperial crans]] of the caviar were served at the lavish [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] feast of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]] and his [[Gender/Legends|bride]] [[Anachro]] the [[H'uun]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. Due to the food ordered, the feast was incredibly expensive and was paid for by Anachro's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Orko]] the H'uun. Ubuuga caviar<ref name="BF:WTFLS" /> shared its name with [[Ubuuga]], a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ubuuga caviar was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] ''[[Boba Fett: When the Fat Lady Swings]]'', which was written by [[John Wagner]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="BF:WTFLS" /> on [[September 18]], [[1996]].<ref name="FatLadyMarvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54033/star_wars_boba_fett_1997_2|text=Star Wars: Boba Fett (1997) #2}}</ref>
